name: 断焰刀鞘
text: 战斗开始时，装备一把断焰刀（攻击力3，距离1，耐久6）。
flavor: 刀断了，鞘还留着那一截的形状。

art.subject: a battered crimson leather scabbard wrapped in iron bands, lying open with a faint orange glow leaking from its mouth

name: 朱雀翎
text: 战斗开始时，将一张火种置入手牌。
flavor: 祭司把它插在发间，它便每天替她落下一粒火。

art.subject: a single long vermilion tail feather floating upright in darkness, its tip smoldering and shedding one glowing ember

name: 焚阳火种
text: 战斗开始时，对一名随机敌人施加3层[灼烧]。（不再自带断焰刀）
flavor: 刀留在了北境，火种却一直揣在怀里。

art.subject: a small bronze brazier cupped in two scarred hands, a tiny sun-bright ember glowing inside it, sparks drifting upward

name: 朱雀尾羽
text: 每当你献出一张牌，获得1点[护甲]。
flavor: 尾羽不烧人，只替主人挡火。

art.subject: a single long vermilion tail feather with golden eyes along its vane, faint flames flickering at its tip, floating over ash

name: 焚城火种
text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加3层[灼烧]。
flavor: 殷都那场火，他家留下了一星。

art.subject: a small iron lantern holding a single ancient ember that never goes out, soot-blackened, tied with a red cord

name: 殷都余灰
flavor: 一把灰，三百年都没凉透。

art.subject: a lacquered box of grey ash with glowing embers still buried inside, a palace roof tile fragment on top
